import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import json, hashlib, math, io
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def measure_lake(inputs):
    root = Path(inputs["root"])
    for path, digest in inputs["source_sha256"].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((root/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, path
    raw = [Path(row["path"]).read_bytes() for row in inputs["pngs"]]
    for row, data in zip(inputs["pngs"], raw):
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == row["sha256"], row["path"]
    w, h = inputs["dimensions"]
    main = json.loads((root/"model/campus/references/satellite-export.json").read_text())["extent"]
    ext = json.loads((root/"model/central-campus/references/satellite-export.json").read_text())["extent"]
    feature = json.loads((root/"model/central-campus/footprints.json").read_text())["features"][0]
    assert feature["id"] == "L01 lake traced shoreline"
    cs = math.cos(math.radians(31.578))
    ox = main["xmin"] + 600/1152*(main["xmax"]-main["xmin"])
    oy = main["ymax"] - 850/1920*(main["ymax"]-main["ymin"])
    polygon = np.array([((ext["xmin"]+p[0]/1800*(ext["xmax"]-ext["xmin"])-ox)*cs,
                         (ext["ymax"]-p[1]/1400*(ext["ymax"]-ext["ymin"])-oy)*cs)
                        for p in feature["pixel_outline"]])
    rx, ry, rz = inputs["camera"]["rotation_euler"]
    sx,cx,sy,cy,sz,cz = math.sin(rx),math.cos(rx),math.sin(ry),math.cos(ry),math.sin(rz),math.cos(rz)
    rotation = np.array([[cz,-sz,0],[sz,cz,0],[0,0,1]]) @ np.array([[cy,0,sy],[0,1,0],[-sy,0,cy]]) @ np.array([[1,0,0],[0,cx,-sx],[0,sx,cx]])
    position = np.array(inputs["camera"]["position"])
    scale = inputs["camera"]["ortho_scale"]
    z = inputs["water_level_m_estimate"]
    local = (np.c_[polygon,np.full(len(polygon),z)]-position) @ rotation
    projected = np.c_[w/2+local[:,0]*w/scale, h/2-local[:,1]*w/scale]
    x0,x1 = max(0,int(np.floor(projected[:,0].min()))), min(w,int(np.ceil(projected[:,0].max()))+1)
    y0,y1 = max(0,int(np.floor(projected[:,1].min()))), min(h,int(np.ceil(projected[:,1].max()))+1)

    def contains(ring,xx,yy):

        inside = np.zeros(xx.shape,dtype=bool)
        for a,b in zip(ring,np.roll(ring,-1,axis=0)):
            if a[1] == b[1]: continue
            inside ^= ((a[1]>yy)!=(b[1]>yy)) & (xx<(b[0]-a[0])*(yy-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1])+a[0])

    mask = contains(polygon,wx,wy)
    distance2 = np.full(wx.shape,np.inf)
    for a,b in zip(polygon,np.roll(polygon,-1,axis=0)):
        delta=b-a
        fraction=np.clip(((wx-a[0])*delta[0]+(wy-a[1])*delta[1])/(delta@delta),0,1)
        distance2=np.minimum(distance2,(wx-a[0]-fraction*delta[0])**2+(wy-a[1]-fraction*delta[1])**2)
